Page 23 Cont.
Feb. 2nd Julius Tabert - 62 - hemoraging continually. Drs. doubt whence the blood taks its source
Mrs. Daisey A. Burk - 46 - Very peculiar skin infection - now about 11 years ... Enrolls To-night promised frequent Comm's
Mrs. Josephine 1 Caddin - 48 - operation threatened ..
Page 24
Rose Gross - 75 - hand caught in wringer and left her hand & arm in Herbert Holstein - 30 - brok knee cap 9 yrs. ago about two yrs. ago it started to give trouble. now some Drs. want to amputate ...
Edna Bauers - 42 - in St. Joe's Dearborn
Joseph Breznau - 46 - held up and robbed Jan. 3rd. Vanished was doped got back after 3 weeks.
Marie Krumhelmer - 30 - fits since 8 yrs. old ...... Mrs. Sophie Gromek - 47 - Asthma has pains in chest also.
Mrs. Alberta Lyons - 24 - appendicitis operation threatened .... escaped
Joseph Abraham - 42 - widower wants daughter to return to him .... Rosemarie Hines - 24 - Keeping company with very undesirable .... non Cath. 45 yrs. old ....
Page 25 Feb.
Philip DeSchrejver
. . Glenn P. Wms. - 58 - wants $92 by next Monday or Tuesday.
7 Eugene Karpus - 35 - raised Cath. fell away from practice of faith "don't want to be hypocrite" in going to holy Mass - Enrolled To-day Genevieve Palace - 32 - Away with T.B. for five yrs. las Sun. Honora Donovan - 52 - Waupun, Wis. - Arthritis, and complication. Was up to Mt. Royal treating 3 yrs. with Dr. Locke. in poor shape Enroll
